thread:
samir: Heads-up — we just saw a tenant (corp-omega) that sent a huge burst of mixed-dim embeddings and our router pushed almost everything to slow-path. p95 for that tenant spiked to ~1.8s.
rachael: ugh. is that the case where they sent a 2k vectors batch with mixed dims + some 1x2048 too?
samir: yep. payload looked like: `[{dims:1536, n:1200}, {dims:2048, n:50}, {dims:512, n:600}]` — splitter couldn't coalesce efficiently and we hit the rate shaper + fallback.
lee: what did the runtime return? 413 or did we chunk?
samir: mostly 413 on the router side when preflight couldn't find a fast route; a few made it but with serialized slowpath processing.
nina: can we do per-tenant burst tokens so sudden spikes get absorbed without blowing up other tenants? e.g., token-bucket with short window that's accounted against quota but not routed to slowpath immediately.
rachael: I like burst tokens. Also think we should add a size_bucket tag to telemetry so we can see distribution quickly — like small/medium/huge by total_bytes and max_dim.
samir: proposed labels: `size_bucket: tiny|small|medium|large|huge`, `max_dim`, `mixed_dims:true|false`. That would let console panels filter spikes.
lee: +1. We should also add `routing_reason` dimension: `fastpath`, `batched_slowpath`, `fallback_split`, `reject_413`.
rachael: concrete plan: 1) router: implement transient burst tokens per tenant (refill short window) 2) telemetry: emit size_bucket & routing_reason 3) console: add p95 latency panel per size_bucket and per-tenant burst usage 4) rollout behind FF canary 10%
nina: how do tokens interact with quotas/console? tokens shouldn't bypass billing quotas; they just change routing preference. we decrement normal units and emit an event.
samir: exactly — tokens are just routing credit, not free. decrement X-Embed-Units for billing as usual. Need to expose token usage metric `embed_burst_tokens_used` in console.
lee: edgecase: if a tenant has cheap/low priority plan we still want to cap bursts. tokens should be bounded by a multiple of their normal rate (e.g., max_burst = min(tenant_cap * 5, 50k units)).
rachael: implementable in router config. Also need graceful degrade: if tokens exhausted, fallback to existing behaviour (split + slowpath or 413 depending on preflight).
nina: UX note: console should show token burn rate and an alert when token burn > 75% sustained for 5m. ops want automated email on that.
samir: on telemetry schema — add tags to existing event: `embed_request` -> add `size_bucket`, `max_dim`, `mixed_dims`, `estimated_units`, `routing_reason`, `token_consumed:true|false`, `token_amount` (int).
lee: for logs, keep the router decision small: `ROUTER_DECISION tenant=corp-omega reason=fallback_split est_units=124000 size_bucket=huge tokens_used=10`. good for grep.
rachael: tests: simulate ramp (10x baseline qps) with mixed dims payloads and check p50/p95 and token metrics. Also ensure billing events still match units deducted.
nina: rollout plan: FF on in staging -> smoke -> canary 5% prod -> 25% -> 100% over 48h, watch p95, 413 count, token burn. rollback if 413 up > 2x baseline or p95 up > 20%.
deploy-bot: deploy initiated: feature-flag=embed-burst-tokens v1 -> staging at 2026-03-21T14:12:00Z
samir: quick implementation sketch for header negotiation: client can optionally send `X-Embed-Estimate-Units: 124000` and `X-Embed-Max-Dim: 2048` — router can use that to make better burst decisions. if absent, use estimator.
lee: careful: we can't trust clients fully. we need server-side cap: `claimed_est = min(client_claim, estimator*2)` to avoid gaming.
rachael: agreed. also add a console hint suggesting SDKs to include these headers to improve routing. docs note.
nina: dashboard panels to add: `embed: token_burn_rate`, `embed: p95_by_size_bucket`, `embed: 413_rate_by_size_bucket`, `embed: routing_reason_breakdown`. Keep 1h/6h/24h views.
samir: timeline: small PR for telemetry + headers (1 day), router token impl (2 days), console panels (1 day), e2e tests + canary (1 day). total ~5 working days.
lee: let's also emit a lightweight sampling of payload shapes for big requests (hash of dims + counts) to investigate problematic clients. sample rate 1/1000 to avoid PII.
rachael: ok. action items: Samir = router PR, Lee = telemetry + log lines, Nina = console panels + alerts, Rachael = docs + SDK hint. I'll file the RFC and break into tasks.
samir: filing RFC now -> https://redwood.internal/rfc/embed-burst-tokens (draft)
rachael: thanks. ping me when PR is up, will review. :thumbsup:
lee: will add metric names to schema PR.
nina: adding alert card to channel ops-alerts once panels exist.
deploy-bot: canary rollout at 2026-03-22T02:30:00Z for 5% traffic
rachael: moving to tracking board. nice work team.
